issue.title: sase sweep persistence fails with Issue not found sase-164; same documents retried every tick
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_backfill.py` sweep path (_swept_refs_after_chunk marks nothing swept when a chunk has errors)

Repro: run artifact_link_backfill on gh_sase-org__sase; sweep persistence fails with 'artifact-link bead event publication failed: Issue not found: sase-164'. Same ~50 documents retried every tick; sweep_remaining grows 256 to 266 over 2026-09-28. Found during plan:202609/artifact_link_backfill_reconcile_timeout.md; out of scope for timeout fix.

Impact: sweep never converges; growing backlog and wasted work every tick.

task_type_fields.repro: Run artifact_link_backfill on gh_sase-org__sase; observe Issue not found: sase-164 and growing sweep_remaining

issue.creation_reason: Plan artifact_link_backfill_reconcile_timeout follow-up 2; filing per plan section 5 after dedupe found no duplicate.

evidence.note: Independent production evidence on 2026-10-20: canonical athena housekeeping log since Oct 13 has 198 missing sase-164 errors, 197 missing sase-102, and 76 missing bob-cli-8s. At 09:37:25 EDT sase-164 still blocks bead projection and 1310 documents remain unswept despite failed_projects=0. Apollo reports bob-cli-5z 165 times and still fails with sweep_remaining=0. Source apply_events_to_beads batches endpoint requests against one store and returns receipt=False on exception. Resolve owner/missing distinctions and isolate invalid endpoints without fabricating publication success. Detailed counters, limits, source paths, and acceptance are in the attached report.

payload.description: Determine whether current log failures duplicate existing work or belong to its causal scope
Check status of existing beads the athena/apollo operational log audit routed evidence to
